Subject: Dedicated capacity demo request — AstroData

Hi Diego / Ben,

I signed up through the self-serve flow earlier today and got routed to the SDR queue — thanks for the quick follow. We are evaluating a Dedicated capacity option to support a production assistant for our analytics product. Before we go deeper I wanted a short technical walkthrough focused on throughput and latency trade-offs.

High level: our typical usage is bursts of concurrent users (20–50) with ~1–2 requests each per minute. Average request payload is ~1,200 tokens and we generally serve completions capped at ~200 tokens. We care about tail latency: 95th <= 300ms if possible for snappy UI. Cost is a factor but reliability comes first for this use case.

Can you do a 30-min demo this week to walk through Dedicated capacity: sizing, expected tokens/sec, autoscale behavior and the per-token cost breakdown? Attaching a small sample telemetry CSV from our prod traces in case that helps.

Thanks,
Samira Nguyen
Head of ML Platform, AstroData
